For ⋆ = × (the Dirichlet tensor ⊗), the uniform Π-form of the internal hom equals the morphism form on the nose: Container.ihom q r ≅ Π_{i∈S_q} (r ◁ (q[i]·y)) as a ContainerIso. This is the container-level ΠΣ≅ΣΠ identity underlying the uniform formula, machine-checked; both round trips rfl, axiom-free (structure/Sigma/Unit eta). Necessity: if (−)⊙_⋆p has a right adjoint for all p, then (−)⋆B is polynomial ∀B. One line: ⟦[y^B,y]_⋆⟧R ≅ Cont(y^R⊙_⋆y^B, y) = Cont(y^{R⋆B},y) ≅ R⋆B, so (−)⋆B is the extension of a container. Corollary: restrict Theorem A to matching sub-collections.
